seasonal_check.what_it_does: flags vegetation-loss polygons whose NDVI also fell in the same windows of earlier years (likely harvest or a seasonal cycle); polygons are never removed

warnings: The two windows are 61 days apart in the seasonal cycle. Vegetation and water change naturally with the season: compare the same time of year in different years to avoid false alarms.
